handoff: Approve: every runs/<unit> caller goes through store unitDir/specRunsDir on schema unitRecordPath, byte-identical output; unit tier + typecheck green, AC2 repo test pinned. Minor: AC2 matcher misses ${spec}/runs/ forms; nit: D2 Facts field deferred to slice 04.

findings.title: AC2 matcher misses a `runs/` segment not followed by a template expression
findings.detail:
BY_HAND = /["'`]runs["'`]|\bruns\/\$\{/ catches join(…, "runs", …) and `runs/${…}`, but not `${spec}/runs/` (the pre-change human.ts lsTree form) or "/runs/" + dir. A regression of that shape would pass AC2's check. No such occurrence exists today (grep of packages/*/src finds only comments and prose).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Widen the matcher to any `/runs/` or `runs/` path segment inside a string or template literal outside comments, with the matcher test extended for `${spec}/runs/`.

findings.title: D2 record-folder field in Facts deferred
findings.detail:
Slice Note: 'the resolver's result reaches decide through Facts (the unit reference), not by calling store.' Decide instead calls the pure schema unitRecordPath (decide stays pure; it does not call store). Deferral is justified: a new Facts field would change the observe snapshots AC1 requires unchanged, and spec Plan prefactor 1 does not list the field. Slice 04 must add it when the story record moves into round folders.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Carry the note into slice 04 (handoff already records it).
